preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of rooms and friends is such that k is less than n, and their product is not greater than 2 * 10^5.
The rooms with friends are between 2 and n.
Each friend is in a unique room.
The rooms connected by each corridor are between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases is not greater than 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of rooms across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output should be either 'YES' if Vlad can guarantee victory or 'NO' if he cannot.

invariants.description: The room system forms an undirected tree, meaning there is a unique path between any two rooms.
Vlad starts the game in room 1.

invariants.expression: Vlad wins if he reaches a room with exactly one exit
invariants.description: Vlad wins if he reaches any room other than room 1, into which exactly one corridor leads.

invariants.expression: Friends win if they meet Vlad
invariants.description: Friends win if they meet Vlad in any room or corridor before he wins.
Each participant can move through one corridor per unit of time, and all participants move at the same time.

invariants.expression: All participants can fit in any room
invariants.description: All participants can be in the same room at the same time.
